summary.text: Chris Knoll is the Republican candidate for Minnesota State Senate District 21 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Democrat Caitlyn Sanow-Minett.
According to his campaign website, he is the CEO of Minnewaska Community Health Services and a licensed nursing home administrator.

paragraphs.text: Knoll's campaign website says he earned a bachelor's degree in public administration from St. Cloud State University and a master's degree in public administration from Minnesota State University, Mankato while working full time.
It says he lives in St. James with his wife, Amanda, and their blended family of four children.
The site lists law and order, stopping fraud and restoring accountability in state programs, and protecting constitutional rights, including the right to bear arms, as his core priorities.
It reports that he won the Republican endorsement in Senate District 21.

sources.title: About - Chris Knoll for Minnesota Senate District 21
